target.title: fix(gateway): drain root work continuations before stop process exit
target.body:
#### What Problem This Solves

Close #105697

When a gateway process receives a direct stop signal (SIGTERM/SIGINT without a restart intent), any `session_end` plugin hooks already started by session reset/delete/compaction may be truncated before they complete. Affected plugins may lose database writes, memory summaries, or external resource cleanups.

#### Why This Change Was Made

Adds a bounded drain of the existing gateway root-work set to the direct-stop path. The drain uses a referenced `setTimeout` poll (not `.unref()`) so the timer keeps the event loop alive. Bounded at 2 seconds; the caller always invokes `exitProcess(0)` after return. Per ClawSweeper clarification: the force-exit watchdog is cleared at `run-loop.ts:705` before `handleStopAfterServerClose` is entered at line 710; the drain is self-bounded by its own referenced timer.

#### User Impact

No visible impact. Pending `session_end` hooks get up to 2 seconds to complete before exit. Stuck hooks cannot block shutdown.

#### Evidence

**1. Real Gateway startup + shutdown log (PR branch, 10 production plugins, Node v22.23.1)**

```
[gateway] loading configuration…
[gateway] resolving authentication…
[gateway] starting...
[secrets] [***S_REF_IGNORED_INACTIVE_SURFACE] channels.discord.***: no enabled account inherits this top-level Discord ***.
[gateway] session: imported legacy session metadata/transcripts into SQLite:
- targets=1 legacyEntries=8 sqliteEntries=8
- importedEntries=8 importedTranscriptEvents=0
[gateway] session: session SQLite migration warnings:
- [entry_invalid] agent:main:cron:4fa39e4c-188d-411d-a223-a81128de1695: Session entry is missing a valid sessionId.
[gateway] starting HTTP server...
[gateway] ⚠️  Gateway is binding to a non-loopback address. Ensure authentication is configured before exposing to public networks.
[health-monitor] started (interval: 300s, startup-grace: 60s, channel-connect-grace: 120s)
[gateway] agent model: vendor/model-name (thinking=off, fast=off)
[gateway] http server listening (10 plugins: acpx, anthropic, browser, canvas, device-pair,
           file-transfer, memory-core, ollama, phone-control, talk-voice; 8.7s)
[gateway] log file: /tmp/openclaw/openclaw-YYYY-MM-DD.log
[gateway] security warning: dangerous config flags enabled: gateway.controlUi.allowInsecureAuth=true,
           gateway.controlUi.dangerouslyDisableDeviceAuth=true. Run `openclaw security audit`.
[gateway] starting channels and sidecars...
[hooks] loaded 4 internal hook handlers
[plugins] embedded acpx runtime backend registered lazily
[gateway] startup outcomes: internal-hooks=loaded; internal-startup-hook=scheduled;
           gateway-start-hooks=scheduled; memory-qmd=skipped (not-configured);
           gmail-watcher=skipped (hooks-disabled); gmail-model=skipped (not-configured)
[gateway] ready
[heartbeat] started
[gateway] agent runtime plugins pre-warmed in 187ms

                                 … gateway running, channels connected …

[gateway] received SIGTERM; shutting down
[gmail-watcher] gmail watcher stopped
[shutdown] completed cleanly in 261ms
```

Gateway under this PR starts cleanly with 10 production plugins (including acpx, browser, canvas, device-pair, file-transfer, memory-core, ollama, phone-control, talk-voice), reaches ready state, and shuts down in 261ms with zero errors.

**2. Drain mechanism proof (12/12 passed)**

Each case: real child process, real `gateway-work-admission` module, real OS SIGTERM, real `waitForGatewayRootWorkDrain()`. Continuations created via the same `root.run()` → `runWithGatewayIndependentRootWorkContinuation()` → `root.release()` pattern as `session-reset-service.ts`.

```
=== Gateway Drain — Real Process Proof ===

[Case 1] No hooks:         exit=0 20ms
[Case 2] 350ms hook+SIGTERM: exit=0 315ms  sentinel=done 1783951839244
[Case 3] Stuck hook:       exit=0 1020ms
[Case 4] 2 concurrent:     exit=0 364ms

=== 12/12 passed ===
```

- Case 2: continuation mid-flight when SIGTERM arrives → drain blocks until hook writes file → file confirmed on disk. Without the drain fix, Node exits before the 350ms write.
- Case 3: never-releasing hook → drain returns false after 1s timeout → exits cleanly
- Case 4: two concurrent hooks → drain waits for slowest → both files confirmed

**3. Unit tests (62 passed)**

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/process/gateway-work-admission.test.ts src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.test.ts
✓ |unit| src/process/gateway-work-admission.test.ts (17 tests)
✓ |cli|  src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.test.ts (45 tests)
Test Files 2 passed (2) | Tests 62 passed (62)
```

**4. Change scope:** 4 files, +116 lines. No config, CLI, SDK, docs, or changelog surface. No new dependencies.
